You are writing one SEO blog page for Kodely (an AI website builder). Output ONLY a single valid JSON object — no markdown fences, no commentary before or after, no prose before or after the JSON. Your entire response must be the JSON object itself, starting with { and ending with }, parseable by JSON.parse(). FACTUAL CONSTRAINTS (mandatory — the brief below was written before a product pivot and contains false claims; correct them, do not copy verbatim): What Kodely actually does (real, shipped, verified today): - User describes a site in plain English in a chat interface. - Kodely generates a REAL Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 app — real component files (.tsx), not raw HTML, not a mockup. - Live preview renders the actual compiled app as it's built. - One-click Publish puts the site live on a real public URL: .kodely.site — free, included. - Further changes: describe them in chat; Kodely edits the real components. - Checkpoints: every successful generation is a restore point; rolling back is free. - Code view: users can see and copy the actual generated source files in-app. No zip export yet. - Credits: metered from real AI cost. A build that fails to compile is never charged. - Free tier: 750 credits on signup, no credit card required. - Paid top-ups: $9 → 500 credits, $40 → 2,500 credits (most popular), $90 → 6,000 credits. Credits never expire. - Every publish is scanned for accidentally-leaked secrets/API keys before going live. What Kodely does NOT do yet — never claim these (the brief below wrongly says "yours to keep" and "first month of hosting free" and references a non-existent "Agency plan" — correct all of this): - No backend, database, auth, or payments generation. Frontend only — a creator's site here means a home base / portfolio / media page, not a monetization backend (no built-in shop, no paywall, no subscriber management). - No custom domains. Only *.kodely.site subdomains today. - No code export/download (zip). "Yours to keep" is misleading — the honest claim is "you can see and copy the code" in-app. - No click-to-edit visual editing. Only chat-based editing exists. - No "first month of hosting free" — FALSE, never use it. - No live "Bring it online with Nxeon" integration. - Not open-source, not self-hostable. - No "Agency plan" or any tier beyond the credit system — pricing is the same for every user. - No analytics/click-tracking built in — if relevant, be upfront about this (relevant if this overlaps with a link-hub use case). - No testimonials exist yet — do NOT invent a fake customer quote. Drop that section from the brief's outline. Voice: direct, confident, specific — never generic AI-marketing language. Write for a real online creator's situation: content lives across platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Substack, etc.) they don't own, and a personal site is the one place that's actually theirs — for a distinct look (not another templated Linktree), a real "about/press kit" style page, or a hub tying everything together. Primary CTA links to /signup. Only link to real pages: /, /pricing, /blog, /signup, /login (may link to /blog/build-a-link-in-bio-page-with-ai, that page exists). IMPORTANT for JSON safety: avoid literal straight double-quotes inside bodyHtml prose; correct HTML/JSON escaping; no literal newline characters inside JSON string values. Do NOT wrap your output in explanatory prose — output must be pure JSON, nothing else. Your audience lives everywhere except somewhere you control

Kodely builds a real site from what you tell it, not a template

Kodely is an AI website builder that works from a chat, not a theme picker. A home base that ties everything together

Point people at one URL instead of five. List your YouTube, your Instagram, your newsletter, your latest drop, in a layout you actually chose instead of a generic link stack.
